projects.title: Global Retail Sales & Profitability Optimization
projects.shortDescription: Comprehensive analysis of 500k+ retail transactions to identify loss-making product sub-categories and optimize regional discounting strategies.
projects.businessProblem: The client experienced a 12% revenue growth year-over-year, but net profit margins plateaued due to unmonitored regional shipping costs and excessive discounting on furniture categories.
objectives: Identify high-performing vs. loss-making product sub-categories across 4 global regions.
Evaluate the impact of discount thresholds on customer order profitability.
Build an interactive executive Power BI dashboard for real-time regional tracking.
projects.datasetDescription: Global Superstore dataset containing 51,290 rows of transactional records, customer demographics, shipping modes, and profit metrics spanning 4 years.
dataCleaningProcess: Handled 412 missing postal codes by performing geospatial imputation based on city and state mappings.
Removed 1,450 duplicate transaction records using Python (Pandas).
Standardized date formats and created calculated columns for profit margin percentage and shipping duration.
projects.exploratoryAnalysis: Analyzed correlation between discount rates and profit. Discovered that discounts exceeding 20% consistently yielded negative net margins across Central and South American regional markets.
projects.codeSnippet: SELECT Region, Sub_Category, SUM(Sales) AS Total_Sales, SUM(Profit) AS Total_Profit, (SUM(Profit) / SUM(Sales)) * 100 AS Profit_Margin FROM retail_transactions WHERE Order_Date >= '2023-01-01' GROUP BY Region, Sub_Category ORDER BY Profit_Margin ASC;
keyInsights: Tables and Bookcases sub-categories operated at a cumulative net loss of $92,000 due to heavy discounting and high freight expenses.
Standard Class shipping accounted for 60% of total volume but maintained the most stable profit margins.
Top 5% of customers contributed 34% of total enterprise revenue.
businessRecommendations: Cap maximum allowable discount at 15% for furniture product lines in low-margin regions.
Restructure logistics contracts with regional courier services in the Central region to reduce shipping overhead by 8%.
Reallocate marketing budget toward high-margin technology products in European and North American markets.

projects.title: E-Commerce Customer Lifetime Value & RFM Segmentation
projects.shortDescription: Machine learning RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) segmentation model categorizing 100,000+ digital shoppers to optimize retention campaigns.
projects.businessProblem: Marketing campaigns suffered from low conversion rates and high customer acquisition costs because promotional emails were broadcast uniformly without behavioral personalization.
objectives: Segment active e-commerce users using K-Means clustering based on purchasing recency, frequency, and monetary spend.
Identify high-risk churn cohorts and pinpoint primary indicators of customer disengagement.
Formulate targeted retention offers tailored to each distinct behavioral segment.
projects.datasetDescription: E-commerce transaction logs including customer ID, invoice numbers, unit pricing, order quantities, and timestamps over a 24-month period.
dataCleaningProcess: Filtered out cancelled orders (invoices starting with 'C') and negative quantities.
Imputed missing customer IDs for guest checkouts where session tokens matched registered accounts.
Normalized monetary values using Log Transformation to correct right-skewness before clustering.
projects.exploratoryAnalysis: Applied the Elbow Method to determine optimal cluster count ($k=5$). Evaluated silhouette scores to validate distinct separation between VIP champions, loyal regulars, and at-risk churners.

VIP Champions generate 48% of total revenue despite making up only 7% of the active user base.
Average order value peaks during holiday promotional windows but drops sharply for new visitors.
businessRecommendations: Launch an automated win-back email sequence offering tailored incentives to the 'At-Risk' cluster at day 75 of inactivity.
Implement a tiered loyalty program rewarding the top 10% spenders with early product access and free expedited shipping.
A/B test onboarding discount structures for first-time visitors to improve conversion.

projects.title: Corporate Financial Health & Cash Flow Forecasting
projects.shortDescription: Dynamic financial model evaluating liquidity ratios, working capital efficiency, and 3-year rolling cash flow projections.
projects.businessProblem: Unpredictable seasonal cash flow fluctuations created short-term working capital crunches, impeding timely inventory procurement and R&D investments.
objectives: Consolidate multi-subsidiary income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow statements into a unified financial repository.
Build an automated 3-year discounted cash flow (DCF) valuation and sensitivity analysis model.
Establish automated variance tracking comparing actual monthly performance against budgeted targets.
projects.datasetDescription: Quarterly financial statements, general ledger extracts, and accounts receivable/payable aging schedules from 2021 to 2025.
dataCleaningProcess: Standardized divergent chart of accounts across 3 acquired subsidiary business units.
Reconciled inter-company transaction eliminations using Power Query merge transformations.
Adjusted historical figures for inflation and foreign exchange rate fluctuations.
projects.exploratoryAnalysis: Calculated key financial ratios including Quick Ratio, Current Ratio, Debt-to-Equity, and Return on Invested Capital (ROIC) across 16 quarters.
keyInsights: Accounts receivable collection period increased by 14 days over the past year, directly constraining operating cash flow.
Operating expenses in administrative overhead grew 18% faster than gross revenue.
Debt service coverage ratio remains robust at 3.4x, well above lender covenants.
businessRecommendations: Enforce stricter 30-day payment terms with Tier-2 clients and introduce early payment discounts (2/10 net 30).
Implement quarterly zero-based budgeting reviews for non-essential administrative expenditures.
Establish a dedicated revolving credit facility to buffer against seasonal receivable lags.

projects.title: HR Workforce Analytics & Employee Attrition Prediction
projects.shortDescription: In-depth workforce analysis identifying primary drivers of employee turnover and evaluating compensation equity across departments.
projects.businessProblem: Rising voluntary turnover among mid-level engineering and sales staff led to increased recruitment costs and project delivery delays.
objectives: Analyze 5 years of HR employee records to identify statistically significant predictors of voluntary turnover.
Assess compensation competitiveness, promotion frequency, and manager effectiveness ratings.
Design a predictive retention scorecard for human resources leadership.
projects.datasetDescription: Anonymous HR dataset comprising 4,400 employee records with 35 demographic, performance, compensation, and tenure attributes.
dataCleaningProcess: Encoded categorical variables (job satisfaction, work-life balance) into ordinal numerical scales.
Handled outlier salary figures by verifying executive compensation tiers against benchmark market data.
Created derived features including tenure-to-promotion ratio and distance-from-home commute impact.
projects.exploratoryAnalysis: Executed SQL queries and logistic regression models to evaluate hazard ratios associated with overtime work, stock option allocation, and years since last promotion.
projects.codeSnippet: SELECT Department, JobRole, COUNT(EmployeeID) AS Total_Staff, SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Leavers, (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Attrition = 'Yes' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(EmployeeID)) * 100 AS Attrition_Rate FROM hr_records GROUP BY Department, JobRole ORDER BY Attrition_Rate DESC;
keyInsights: Employees working frequent mandatory overtime exhibited a 3.2x higher likelihood of voluntary resignation.
Lack of clear promotion pathways within 3 years was the primary driver of attrition among senior technical staff.
Commute distance exceeding 45 minutes strongly correlated with early tenure departure.
businessRecommendations: Restructure overtime distribution policies and introduce compensatory time-off incentives for engineering teams.
Establish structured bi-annual career milestone reviews and transparent upward mobility pathways.
Expand hybrid remote-work flexibility to mitigate commute friction for regional staff.
